what: Take-Two Interactive publishes video games through Rockstar Games, maker of Grand Theft Auto, 2K, which publishes NBA 2K and other sports titles, and Zynga, which makes mobile games.
customers: Console, PC and mobile gamers worldwide, plus platform holders such as Sony, Microsoft and the app stores.
money: Grand Theft Auto, NBA 2K, Red Dead and other titles plus in-game spending
Zynga's casual and social games with in-app purchases
moat: Grand Theft Auto, the most valuable entertainment franchise in the world by revenue per release, and NBA 2K's exclusive basketball licence.
risks: Grand Theft Auto VI has been delayed more than once, and the whole business is weighted to it
It reported a loss in the latest period after goodwill charges on the mobile business
Zynga's mobile titles face rising user acquisition costs
opportunities: Revenue grew about 18% last year ahead of the next major release
Analysts see about 34% upside from current levels
Recurrent spending inside games now provides a large and steadier revenue stream
watch: The Grand Theft Auto VI release date and recurrent consumer spending growth.
